sigma.floor: quantization step / sqrt(12) of the coarsest sensor
sigma.rationale: ADR-008 §C: sigma is the robust scale (1.4826 MAD) of every 2018 out-of-fold window, documented as conservative; the leak masks (reparados, reparados+crescimento recommended by P1, todos) are reported as sensitivity only, because they keep only 2-43 % of the year, concentrated in a few months. The floor is the rounding noise of the measurement (step/sqrt(12)) of the coarsest sensor: below it sigma would measure the display resolution, not the forecaster.

persistence.rationale: Operational definition of ADR-008 §D (sentinel.detection.offline.persistence), fixed before any XGBoost residual is read. Displacement = mean z over a span minus the sensor's mean over the 24 h before the start (removes the offset of the other active leaks; a full day, so no diurnal bias). Initial span (start, start+1h]; remaining span (start+24h, start+25h], the same hours of the day. Affected sensors = the 3 with the largest initial displacement (the middle of the N grid 1..5). Persistence = sum of remaining / sum of initial. Thresholds as proposed on 2026-10-17 (PR #16): median >= 50 % and no leak < 25 % over the 6 abrupt leaks of 2018; an undefined ratio counts as 0.

delta.rationale: Amends the PR #16 proposal (delta = 1 sigma). delta_N = the smallest, over the 6 abrupt leaks of 2018, of the N-th largest sustained displacement (mean z over (start, start+24h] minus the 24 h before): the shift the CUSUM must see on N sensors to detect the weakest abrupt leak. k_N = delta_N / 2 rounded to 2 decimals, for the cells with that N (the CUSUM is tuned to the shift it must find on the N sensors that open the alert). An N with k_N <= 0 leaves the grid. Fixed before any detection result; the sweep never chooses k.
